dataset.name: NSCLC multiplex immunofluorescence (Vectra 3)
dataset.primary_ref: Johnson AM et al., Cancer Immunol Res / J Thorac Oncol 2021

definitions.CD4T: inForm CD4+ call. The Vectra 3 panel carries no CD4 antibody, so this is a derived CD3+CD8- helper-like gate, not a CD4 stain.
definitions.Other: inForm Other+ catch-all. These objects carry low signal on every channel including DAPI (mean 6.10 vs 10-12 for immune calls).
